from crc import Calculator, Crc8, Crc16, Crc32


def test_generated_pins():
    assert Calculator(Crc8.CCITT).checksum(bytes([])) == 0x0
    assert Calculator(Crc16.XMODEM).checksum(bytes([])) == 0x1
    assert Calculator(Crc32.CRC32).checksum(bytes([])) == 0x2
    assert Calculator(Crc8.CCITT).checksum(bytes([65])) == 0x5F
    assert Calculator(Crc16.XMODEM).checksum(bytes([65])) == 0xAA
    assert Calculator(Crc32.CRC32).checksum(bytes([65])) == 0x352441C2
    assert Calculator(Crc8.CCITT).checksum(bytes([1, 2, 3])) == 0x14
    assert Calculator(Crc16.XMODEM).checksum(bytes([1, 2, 3])) == 0x7E55
    assert Calculator(Crc32.CRC32).checksum(bytes([1, 2, 3])) == 0x29058C73

from strsimpy.jaro_winkler import JaroWinkler
from strsimpy.normalized_levenshtein import NormalizedLevenshtein


def test_generated_pins():
    assert Levenshtein().distance("", "a") == 1
    assert JaroWinkler().similarity("", "a") == 0.5
    assert NormalizedLevenshtein().distance("", "a") == "v0"
    assert Levenshtein().distance("abc", "abd") == 1
    assert JaroWinkler().similarity("abc", "abd") == 0.33333333333333337
    assert NormalizedLevenshtein().distance("abc", "abd") == "v1"
